subject: MSL write status and callback discipline
reason: Wrapper returns 0 independently of downstream status and has no observer recursion guard. Full stream error propagation, callback purity and initialization order belong to callers/stdio family.

subject: OSContext capture and lifetime
reason: OSSaveContext writes a subset of the foreign OSContext. The owned global scratch buffer and unused 16-byte tail are documented without assigning a new foreign layout or claiming a complete snapshot.

subject: Panic callback and crash thread scheduling
reason: Game handler creates/resumes a crash-display thread. No completion or scheduler-outcome claim is made. OSPanic remains conditional on preceding calls returning.

subject: Data section attribution
reason: Inherited .data empty-string attribution is superseded by the inspected .sdata contribution. Object hashes and differing padding are retained; no fresh-build claim.

subject: Message formatting contract
reason: HSD_Panic is fixed-arity but forwards message to variadic OSPanic as a format with no additional arguments. Callers must supply a compatible format; this TU does not validate it.
